snapshot.h2: Wynwood decides where to eat on the sidewalk
paragraphsHtml: Wynwood grew around art, not food. Many people on NW 2nd Avenue came for the murals, not for you, and they choose where to eat on the spot: a quick "tacos near me" search, a look at your photos, a decision in seconds.

Art Basel week in early December and Miami Music Week in March bring waves of visitors who are already here and hungry. The quieter weeks lean on locals, so a plan that knows what is coming fills more seats.

proof.relation: Closest case study, in Downtown Miami
chips: Pop-ups in Brickell and Sunset Harbour
proof.bodyHtml: A ramen shop that has moved more than once, from Southwest Ranches to pop-ups to a Downtown food hall. Each move meant telling regulars where to find it and winning over a new neighborhood.

steps.h2: What we'd do first in Wynwood

items.title: Make your Google listing walk-in ready
items.bodyHtml: Current hours, bright food photos, a working menu link and recent reviews decide whether a nearby searcher walks over. Our Google Business Profile service keeps it that way.

items.title: Shoot video that holds its own next to the murals
items.bodyHtml: Reels and TikToks of your plates, your bar and your room, filmed by our crew at your restaurant. Food close-ups usually happen before doors open. See our social media and content service.

items.title: Line up event weeks early
items.bodyHtml: Content, ads and a menu plan ready a few weeks before Basel and Music Week, so you catch the crowd instead of watching it pass.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Wynwood?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with restaurants, bars and cafes across Miami and South Florida, Wynwood included. Our closest case study is Shimuja Ramen in Downtown Miami.

faqs.q: Can you shoot content while we are open?
faqs.a: Yes. If you want a full room on camera, we plan the shoot so we stay out of your staff's way. Food and drink close-ups usually work best before service.

faqs.q: How should I market my restaurant around Art Basel?
faqs.a: Start several weeks ahead: content that shows what is special that week, ads aimed at visitors nearby, and accurate hours on Google.

faqs.q: Do you make content in Spanish?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team is bilingual, so captions, review replies, ads and your website can run in English, Spanish or both.

cta.body: Tell us about your restaurant and your slow nights, and Juan will tell you what we would do first. Free, in English or Spanish.
